limitations: The invariant concerns pairwise read-vector distance exactly two, not deletion-ball confusion, higher read distances, clique cover or independent-set numbers, nor a common single-error output.
scientific_integrity: The read-distance-two edge characterization is established in prior work; the stated all-parameter maximum clique size, complete extremal classification and count are the claim reviewed here. A finite verifier independently enumerates small labeled graphs; the all-parameter result relies on the written argument.
title: Maximum pairwise-confusability cliques in two-symbol composition reads
